provenance.archive_discovery: Sorted root.glob("*/*.f3d") in the saved capture layout; no temporary discovery file is read.

raw_initial_generic_counted_extents.scope: Literal counted length/component/terminator observations only; includes empty names rejected by the production payload parser, and does not qualify owners or semantic identity.

initial_generic_payload_framing.scope: Ordinary strict nonempty topology naming payloads only; separately qualified nested metadata is excluded from these counts.

nested_metadata_payload_framing.scope: Empty-name opt-in only for shared-reader-qualified singleton metadata whose immediate owner is an attribute and whose BODY/FACE root owner and parent chain are explicit. These records are not topology naming candidates.

namespace_scope: Owner pointers are resolved through initial-plus-trailing geometry-entity ordinals, excluding section markers/history records. Attribute and owner inspection indices are separately retained; equality in initial geometry does not merge the namespaces.
